top.line: AgentiCCells: a new company that sets up small agentic teams in the customer's environment, with a control centre.
top.para: Everything open, no state on our side; researched, reviewed and set up in a day.

in-short.line: The company, the model, the research, the review, and the setup.

origin.line: Today's articles on brains, data lakes, decisions, mini teams and the console needed a company.
origin.para: The skill is rare, control sells it, and the software is open.

name.line: AgentiCCells: Agent, CC for Creative Commons, Cells; always plural.
name.para: CC also reads as Claude Code; check the trademark before the logo.

sells.line: Atomic cells in the customer's environment, with a control centre, from £500 to £20,000.
sells.para: No state, atomic, open, cheaper than doing it yourself.

research.line: Two Perplexity briefs mapped 30+ vendors: the cheap end is crowded, the top is open.
research.para: Nobody packages conductors, policies and a control centre as an open service.

review.line: Strong: setup over software, no state, cells. To fix: pricing, commissions, console location, the RiskMandate split.

setup.line: agenticcells.ai, .com and .app; Route 53; a GitHub repository; a bootstrap brief for the first team.
setup.para: Customer sites on their own domain, one CNAME each, deleted on exit.

limits.line: A first proposal, reported vendor facts, and a company a day old.

sources.line: Two research briefs, the review, and the setup itself.
